measurement.query:
SELECT DISTINCT CAST(s.s_acctbal * 100 AS BIGINT),
    s.s_name, n.n_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_mfgr, s.s_address, s.s_phone, s.s_comment
FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
WHERE p.p_size = 15 AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS' AND r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
AND ps.ps_supplycost = (
    SELECT MIN(ps2.ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp ps2
    JOIN supplier s2 ON s2.s_suppkey = ps2.ps_suppkey
    JOIN nation n2 ON n2.n_nationkey = s2.s_nationkey
    JOIN region r2 ON r2.r_regionkey = n2.n_regionkey
    WHERE ps2.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey AND r2.r_name = 'EUROPE')

WITH matches AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost
    FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
    JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'GERMANY')
SELECT ps_partkey, CAST(SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) * 100 AS BIGINT)
FROM matches GROUP BY ps_partkey
HAVING SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) >
    (SELECT SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) * 0.0001 FROM matches)

measurement.query:
WITH revenue AS (
    SELECT l_suppkey AS supplier_key,
        CAST(SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) * 10000 AS BIGINT) AS total_revenue
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT l_orderkey, l_linenumber, l_suppkey,
        l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_shipdate FROM lineitem
        WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1996-04-01') matches
    GROUP BY l_suppkey)
SELECT DISTINCT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_phone, r.total_revenue
FROM supplier s JOIN revenue r ON s.s_suppkey = r.supplier_key
WHERE r.total_revenue = (SELECT MAX(total_revenue) FROM revenue)

measurement.query:
WITH quantities AS (
    SELECT l_orderkey, CAST(SUM(l_quantity) * 100 AS BIGINT) AS sum_quantity
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT l_orderkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity FROM lineitem) AS lines
    GROUP BY l_orderkey HAVING SUM(l_quantity) > 300.00
)
SELECT DISTINCT c.c_name, c.c_custkey, o.o_orderkey,
    (o.o_orderdate - DATE '1970-01-01')::INTEGER AS o_orderdate,
    CAST(o.o_totalprice * 100 AS BIGINT) AS total_price, q.sum_quantity
FROM quantities q JOIN orders o ON q.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey

measurement.query:
SELECT DISTINCT s.s_name, s.s_address
FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
WHERE n.n_name = 'CANADA' AND s.s_suppkey IN (
    SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps
    WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_name LIKE 'forest%')
    AND ps.ps_availqty > 0.5 * (
        SELECT SUM(l.l_quantity) FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT l_orderkey, l_linenumber, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_quantity, l_shipdate
            FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1994-01-01'
                AND l_shipdate < DATE '1995-01-01') l
        WHERE l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey))

measurement.method: CLI .timer real wall time for complete authored SELECT; 1 ms resolution; one process per thread count
measurement.query:
SELECT c_custkey, c_name,
    CAST(SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) * 10000 AS BIGINT) AS revenue,
    CAST(c_acctbal * 100 AS BIGINT) AS account_balance, n_name, c_address, c_phone, c_comment
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, c.c_nationkey,
    c.c_address, c.c_phone, c.c_comment, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate,
    l.l_linenumber, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_returnflag, n.n_name
    FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
    WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1994-01-01'
      AND l.l_returnflag = 'R') AS matches
GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name, c_acctbal, n_name, c_address, c_phone, c_comment

measurement.query:
SELECT DISTINCT o.o_orderkey, p.p_partkey, s.s_suppkey
FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation nc ON c.c_nationkey = nc.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON nc.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
JOIN nation ns ON s.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey
WHERE r.r_name = 'AMERICA' AND p.p_type = 'ECONOMY ANODIZED STEEL'
AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1996-12-31'

SELECT DISTINCT o.o_orderkey, p.p_partkey, ns.n_nationkey
FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN nation nc ON nc.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
JOIN nation ns ON ns.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-04-01'
AND nc.n_name = 'UNITED STATES' AND ps.ps_availqty > 0

measurement.method: CLI .timer real wall time for complete authored SELECT; 1 ms resolution; one process per thread count
measurement.query:
SELECT DISTINCT CAST(s.s_acctbal * 100 AS BIGINT),
    s.s_name, n.n_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_mfgr, s.s_address, s.s_phone, s.s_comment
FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
WHERE p.p_size = 15 AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS' AND r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
AND ps.ps_supplycost = (
    SELECT MIN(ps2.ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp ps2
    JOIN supplier s2 ON s2.s_suppkey = ps2.ps_suppkey
    JOIN nation n2 ON n2.n_nationkey = s2.s_nationkey
    JOIN region r2 ON r2.r_regionkey = n2.n_regionkey
    WHERE ps2.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey AND r2.r_name = 'EUROPE')

measurement.query:
WITH matches AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost
    FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
    JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'GERMANY')
SELECT ps_partkey, CAST(SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) * 100 AS BIGINT)
FROM matches GROUP BY ps_partkey
HAVING SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) >
    (SELECT SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) * 0.0001 FROM matches)

measurement.query:
WITH revenue AS (
    SELECT l_suppkey AS supplier_key,
        CAST(SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) * 10000 AS BIGINT) AS total_revenue
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT l_orderkey, l_linenumber, l_suppkey,
        l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_shipdate FROM lineitem
        WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1996-04-01') matches
    GROUP BY l_suppkey)
SELECT DISTINCT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_phone, r.total_revenue
FROM supplier s JOIN revenue r ON s.s_suppkey = r.supplier_key
WHERE r.total_revenue = (SELECT MAX(total_revenue) FROM revenue)

measurement.query:
WITH quantities AS (
    SELECT l_orderkey, CAST(SUM(l_quantity) * 100 AS BIGINT) AS sum_quantity
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT l_orderkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity FROM lineitem) AS lines
    GROUP BY l_orderkey HAVING SUM(l_quantity) > 300.00
)
SELECT DISTINCT c.c_name, c.c_custkey, o.o_orderkey,
    (o.o_orderdate - DATE '1970-01-01')::INTEGER AS o_orderdate,
    CAST(o.o_totalprice * 100 AS BIGINT) AS total_price, q.sum_quantity
FROM quantities q JOIN orders o ON q.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey

SELECT DISTINCT s.s_name, s.s_address
FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
WHERE n.n_name = 'CANADA' AND s.s_suppkey IN (
    SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps
    WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_name LIKE 'forest%')
    AND ps.ps_availqty > 0.5 * (
        SELECT SUM(l.l_quantity) FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT l_orderkey, l_linenumber, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_quantity, l_shipdate
            FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1994-01-01'
                AND l_shipdate < DATE '1995-01-01') l
        WHERE l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey))

measurement.method: CLI .timer real wall time for complete authored SELECT; 1 ms resolution; one process per thread count
measurement.query:
SELECT c_custkey, c_name,
    CAST(SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) * 10000 AS BIGINT) AS revenue,
    CAST(c_acctbal * 100 AS BIGINT) AS account_balance, n_name, c_address, c_phone, c_comment
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, c.c_nationkey,
    c.c_address, c.c_phone, c.c_comment, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate,
    l.l_linenumber, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_returnflag, n.n_name
    FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
    WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1994-01-01'
      AND l.l_returnflag = 'R') AS matches
GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name, c_acctbal, n_name, c_address, c_phone, c_comment

measurement.method: CLI .timer real wall time for complete authored SELECT; 1 ms resolution; one process per thread count
measurement.query:
SELECT DISTINCT o.o_orderkey, p.p_partkey, s.s_suppkey
FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation nc ON c.c_nationkey = nc.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON nc.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
JOIN nation ns ON s.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey
WHERE r.r_name = 'AMERICA' AND p.p_type = 'ECONOMY ANODIZED STEEL'
AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1996-12-31'

measurement.query:
SELECT DISTINCT o.o_orderkey, p.p_partkey, ns.n_nationkey
FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN nation nc ON nc.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
JOIN nation ns ON ns.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-04-01'
AND nc.n_name = 'UNITED STATES' AND ps.ps_availqty > 0
